# mv: convert method expression call T.M(t, args...) to function call
mv T.M F
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

func (t T) M(n int) int { return t.X + n }

func G() int {
	var t T
	return T.M(t, 1)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,9 +2,9 @@

 type T struct{ X int }

-func (t T) M(n int) int { return t.X + n }
+func F(t T, n int) int { return t.X + n }

 func G() int {
 	var t T
-	return T.M(t, 1)
+	return F(t, 1)
 }
